name: Saros 10R
measure_description: Whole dock + robot measured at the wall with a ThirdReality Gen3 plug (2 s / 3 W power reporting, 1 Wh energy counter) over Oct 20-26 2026 runs and manual washes; activity energies cross-checked against the plug's energy counter. Activities come from the dock's dust_emptying, mop_washing and mop_drying switches and the robot's status and battery. Sub-profiles match the dock's mop wash temperature setting: hot, warm and room_temperature. Branch values are total wall power: 0.3 W with the robot away (dock alone), 3.5 W with the robot docked at 100%. Charging is mapped from battery % using a clean slow-mode charge (Oct 24, 14% to 100%, washing and drying off): 23 W at the wall rising to 26.6 W near 85-91%, then tapering to ~16 W above ~92%. A ~10 min ~10 W pause before charging from very low battery is not modelled. Robot label: model S91COP, product ID S10R51-01, rated input 20 V / 2.5 A (US 120 V).
